Name: Marble Arch
Location: Marble Arch, 73 Rochdale Road, Manchester, M4 4HY, United Kingdom
Real cider evidence: Real cider documented; check product and stock
Why visit: The strongest single match for this trip: a working cask pub in a lavish Victorian interior, with serious cider and a kitchen that makes it sensible to stay for a meal. Look at the glazed walls, decorative ceiling and famously sloping mosaic floor…
Beer: Marble cask is the main draw; CAMRA lists Manchester Bitter and Pint among the regular beers. The official site advertises nine handpulls, while CAMRA describes six cask lines:…
Cider and perry: CAMRA explicitly reports changing real ciders on draught and in bottles; ask what is available and whether any perry is in stock. Central Manchester CAMRA Cider Pub of the Year…
Food: British pub dishes, including steak-and-stout pie; vegetarian/vegan options and Sunday roasts. Book a meal, particularly Sunday lunch.
Visit note: If flight arrival permits; do not assume a meal.
